caption:
🏙️ Rotterdam, every building standing today by year of construction — 1850 → 2025.

On 14 May 1940 German bombing razed the old centre. Only surviving buildings are shown, so the heart of the city stays dark until the 1950s, then lights up in post-war colours, while the 19th-century and interwar districts around it survived. The skyline by the river is the 2000s.

📊 Data: BAG building register (Kadaster, CC0); heights 3D BAG (TU Delft / 3DGI, CC BY 4.0). About 3,400 buildings recorded with the placeholder year 1941, mostly in the 1916–1930s garden village of Vreewijk, are spread block by block over 1916–1940. Heights exaggerated ×3.
🌍 Map: OpenStreetMap contributors; districts CBS.
